description:
Title: OEE

Write a process, that collects relevant information from a machine, and calculated the Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE).
If the OEE falls below a certain value/percentage, stop the machine and send an email to an engineer.
When the machine is restarted, continue measuring.
When the machine is disconnected, stop the process.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OEE"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/oee">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OEE_Alert" name="OEE alert email"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OEE">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OEE_Process" name="OEE monitoring" processRef="Process_OEE"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Engineer" name="Engineer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OEE_Alert"
                      name="OEE alert email"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendEmail"
                      targetRef="Participant_Engineer"
                      messageRef="Message_OEE_Alert"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OEE" name="OEE" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Monitoring" name="Start monitoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckConnection"
                           name="Machine disconnected?"
                           default="Flow_Connection_Connected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant machine information"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CalculateOEE" name="Calculate Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE)"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckOEE"
                           name="OEE below threshold?"
                           default="Flow_OEE_NotBelow"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StopMachine" name="Stop machine"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendEmail"
                   name="Send email to engineer"
                   messageRef="Message_OEE_Alert"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForRestartOrDisconnection"
                            name="Wait for machine restart or disconnection"
                            eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_MachineRestarted">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">machineRestarted</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_MachineDisconnected">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">machineDisconnected</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ResumeMeasuring" name="Continue measuring"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Disconnected" name="Process stopped because machine is disconnected"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_ConnectionCheck"
                       sourceRef="StartEvent_Monitoring"
                       targetRef="Gateway_CheckConnection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Connection_Disconnected"
                       name="Disconnected"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_CheckConnection"
                       targetRef="EndEvent_Disconnected">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">machineDisconnected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Connection_Connected"
                       name="Connected"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_CheckConnection"
                       targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_To_Calculate"
                       sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation"
                       targetRef="Task_CalculateOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Calculate_To_CheckOEE"
                       sourceRef="Task_CalculateOEE"
                       targetRef="Gateway_CheckOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEE_Below"
                       name="Below threshold"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_CheckOEE"
                       targetRef="Task_StopMachine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">oee < threshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEE_NotBelow"
                       name="Not below threshold"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_CheckOEE"
                       targetRef="Gateway_CheckConnection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stop_To_Email"
                       sourceRef="Task_StopMachine"
                       targetRef="Task_SendEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_To_Wait"
                       sourceRef="Task_SendEmail"
                       targetRef="Gateway_WaitForRestartOrDisconnection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_To_Restart"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForRestartOrDisconnection"
                       targetRef="Event_MachineRestarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_To_Disconnected"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForRestartOrDisconnection"
                       targetRef="Event_MachineDisconnected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restart_To_ResumeMeasuring"
                       sourceRef="Event_MachineRestarted"
                       targetRef="Task_ResumeMeasuring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResumeMeasuring_To_ConnectionCheck"
                       sourceRef="Task_ResumeMeasuring"
                       targetRef="Gateway_CheckConnection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disconnected_To_End"
                       sourceRef="Event_MachineDisconnected"
                       targetRef="EndEvent_Disconnected"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
